_meta.description: SiliconDreams 财务指标口径字典

revenue.definition_zh: 公司在指定报告期直接披露并统一换算为十亿美元的营业收入。
revenue.definition_en: Revenue directly reported for the period and normalized to USD billions.
revenue.comparison_note_zh: 台积电与中芯国际季度数据均为直接披露的美元营收，可横向比较。
revenue.comparison_note_en: Quarterly TSMC and SMIC figures are directly reported in USD and are comparable.

gross_margin.definition_zh: 毛利占营收的比例；季度值采用公司直接披露口径。
gross_margin.definition_en: Gross profit as a percentage of revenue, using the companies' reported quarterly measure.
gross_margin.comparison_note_zh: 两家公司均直接披露季度毛利率，可横向比较。
gross_margin.comparison_note_en: Both companies directly report quarterly gross margin, so the values are comparable.

operating_margin.definition_zh: 营业利润占营收的比例。台积电直接披露；中芯国际需用官方营业利润除以官方营收派生。
operating_margin.definition_en: Operating profit as a percentage of revenue. TSMC reports it directly; SMIC requires derivation from reported operating profit and revenue.
operating_margin.comparison_note_zh: 必须将中芯国际数值标为派生值并通过 Decimal 计算器计算，不得伪装成直接披露。
operating_margin.comparison_note_en: SMIC must be labelled as derived and calculated with the Decimal tool, never presented as directly reported.

net_margin.definition_zh: 归属口径净利润占营收的比例；仅在利润归属和期间口径一致时比较。
net_margin.definition_en: Net income as a percentage of revenue; compare only when attribution and period scope match.
net_margin.comparison_note_zh: 比较前必须核对归母/合并口径以及币种、期间是否一致。
net_margin.comparison_note_en: Confirm attribution, consolidation scope, currency and period before comparison.

capex_intensity.definition_zh: 资本开支除以同期营收，用于衡量扩产投入强度。
capex_intensity.definition_en: Capital expenditure divided by revenue for the same period.
capex_intensity.comparison_note_zh: 必须使用同期间、同币种数据并通过 Decimal 计算器派生。
capex_intensity.comparison_note_en: Use the same period and currency and derive the ratio with the Decimal calculator.

rd_intensity.definition_zh: 研发费用占同期营收的比例。
rd_intensity.definition_en: Research and development expense as a percentage of revenue for the same period.
rd_intensity.comparison_note_zh: 需统一研发费用定义、期间和币种；未直接披露时使用 Decimal 计算器。
rd_intensity.comparison_note_en: Align R&D definitions, period and currency; use the Decimal calculator when derived.
